title: Topology - Of a Slow Collapse
description:
Recorded live with two other friends at ACC's Studio A. This album was done using hardware synths, a mixer, a sampler, various acoustic instruments, and tons of effect pedals. I played synth, guitar, hi-hat, and did lots of mixer manipulation as we took advantage of effect sends to transform our collective sound. 

This was my first time recording and mixing anything. There's plenty I'd do differently on both fronts, but I'm proud of it for what it is given my experience at the time. 

My personal favorite is track two. 

 For fans of: Noise, Ambient, Post-Rock, Avant-Garde, Field Recordings, and Experimental music.
